name: net_zero_offset_credit_purchase_cost
question_template: A company's GHG inventory for the reporting year shows Scope 1 emissions S1={S1} tCO2e and location-based Scope 2 emissions S2={S2} tCO2e. It retires renewable energy certificates covering p={REC_PCT} percent of Scope 2, so market-based Scope 2 equals the uncovered share of S2. Its net-zero reporting policy offsets all Scope 1 plus market-based Scope 2 with carbon credits of one tCO2e each, bought only in whole credits (any fractional ton of residual emissions requires one additional credit) at c={PRICE} USD per credit. Use exact arithmetic. Compute the total credit purchase cost in USD.

slots.description: Exact market-based Scope 2 emissions in tCO2e.
Exact residual emissions to be offset in tCO2e.
Whole number of carbon credits purchased.

program:
def solve():
    s1 = P["S1"]
    s2 = P["S2"]
    p = P["REC_PCT"]
    c = P["PRICE"]
    market_based_scope2 = s2 * (1 - p / 100)
    residual = s1 + market_based_scope2
    credits = math.ceil(residual)
    cost = credits * c
    return {
        "final": cost,
        "market_based_scope2_trace": market_based_scope2,
        "residual_emissions_trace": residual,
        "credits_required_trace": credits,
    }
